name: RevBoost Cash on Delivery Popup for WooCommerce
author: RevBoostLab

sections.description:
RevBoost Cash on Delivery Popup for WooCommerce lets customers place Cash on Delivery (COD) orders directly from the product page, shop loop, or cart page — saving time and eliminating multi-step checkout friction.

It replaces the standard checkout process with a single-click COD Popup Modal, reducing cart abandonment and providing a faster buying experience for your customers.

Live Demo — Test the COD popup, order bump, and customizer live on our demo store before installing.

Optimize Your Store for Cash on Delivery (COD)

Many customers prefer Cash on Delivery because of its trust and convenience. Instead of loading multiple pages, filling out long forms, and choosing payment methods, users simply click your COD button, enter their details in a lightbox popup, and confirm their order instantly.

Key Features

  • Direct Product Page Quick Order — Let customers purchase instantly from single product pages, bypassing the default cart and checkout pages.
  • Animated COD Button — Add shake or pulse animations to your COD buttons to draw visitors’ attention to the quick checkout option.
  • High-Converting COD Popup Form — Lightbox checkout modal captures customer details (Name, Phone, Address, Email, City) quickly.
  • Smart Upsell Order Bumps — Showcase related products or global fallback items as checkout bumps directly inside the popup. Customers can add them with a single click.
  • Dynamic Delivery Charge Selector — Let users select their shipping area (e.g., Inside City vs. Outside City) and see the delivery fee update in real-time.
  • Live Customizer Mockup Settings — Pick colors for the button, button text, popup header background, and header text, with a real-time admin preview.
  • WooCommerce Billing Fields Integration — Dynamically map standard WooCommerce billing fields to ensure compatibility with your order management systems.
  • Fully Responsive & Mobile Optimized — Works flawlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Secure AJAX Requests — Built using WordPress security standards with anti-CSRF nonce tokens to protect checkout transactions.

What’s New

  • Animated COD Trigger Button — Upgrade to RevBoost COD Premium to unlock 10 premium animation styles including Pulse Glow, Shimmer Slide, Neon Glow, Heartbeat, Radar Ping, and more.
  • Professional Loading State (Premium) — When a customer submits their order, the popup confirm button shows a polished spinner so users know their order is being processed.
  • Custom Button Labels per Animation (Premium) — Set a unique trigger button text and popup confirm button text for each of the 10 animation styles independently.

Free vs Premium

Included in Free:

  • ✅ COD Popup Modal
  • ✅ Order Bumps / Upsell
  • ✅ Dynamic Delivery Charges
  • ✅ Live Customizer Preview
  • ✅ Animated COD Button (basic)

Premium Only — Get RevBoost COD Premium:

  • ⭐ 10 Premium Animation Styles (Pulse Glow, Shimmer, Heartbeat, Radar Ping & more)
  • ⭐ Per-Animation Color Control (background + text)
  • ⭐ Custom Button Label per Animation
  • ⭐ Custom Popup Label per Animation
  • ⭐ Professional Order Loading State (spinner)

Privacy Policy

RevBoost Cash on Delivery Popup uses the RevBoostLab SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. The SDK does not gather any data by default. Data collection only begins after the site administrator explicitly opts in through the permission notice shown on the plugin’s settings page.

What data may be collected (only after opt-in):

  • Site URL
  • Administrator email address
  • WordPress version
  • PHP version
  • Plugin version and slug
  • List of active plugins

This data is sent to the RevBoostLab servers and is used solely to:

  • Improve plugin compatibility and stability
  • Send important plugin update and security notices

You are never required to opt in. You may decline the opt-in notice at any time. If you have previously opted in, you can opt out by visiting the plugin’s settings page and withdrawing consent from the SDK notice.

For full details, please review the RevBoostLab Privacy Policy.

External Services

This plugin relies on the RevBoostLab SDK for the following external service connections:

Plugin Update Checks

The plugin periodically contacts the RevBoostLab API to check for available updates. This request includes the plugin slug and current version number. No personally identifiable information is transmitted for update checks.

Opt-In Telemetry (user-initiated only)

If the administrator explicitly opts in via the SDK permission prompt, basic site and plugin data (listed in the Privacy Policy section above) is sent to the RevBoostLab API.

  • API Endpoint: https://revboostlab.com/wp-json/sacfw/v1
  • Data transmitted: Site URL, admin email, WP/PHP/plugin version, active plugin list
  • Trigger: Only after explicit administrator opt-in — never automatically

Deactivation Feedback

When the plugin is deactivated, an optional feedback form is shown. If the administrator chooses to submit feedback, the selected reason and an optional message are sent to the RevBoostLab API. Submitting this form is entirely voluntary.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire revboost-cod-popup-for-woocommerce directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the COD Popup menu in your WP-Admin sidebar.
  4. Enable preferred Checkout Fields, set Shipping Fees, configure Upsell logic, customize colors, and click Save.
sections.faq:
Does this replace the default WooCommerce checkout page?

No. The default WooCommerce checkout page remains fully functional. This plugin adds a quick order fast-track option directly on product pages and loop pages to capture impulsive sales instantly.

Can I use this for other payment methods besides Cash on Delivery?

This plugin is specifically optimized for Cash on Delivery (COD) to streamline quick checkout. It automatically assigns the “COD” payment method to orders created via the popup modal.

How does the Order Bump (Upsell) feature work?

You can enable Order Bumps in the settings. You can choose to dynamically pull upsell products defined inside WooCommerce (Linked Products) or select specific global fallback products that will show up as checkbox offers in the checkout modal.

Can I customize the delivery/shipping fees?

Yes! You can enable custom shipping fees and define different prices and labels for “Inside City” and “Outside City” areas. The popup modal recalculates the grand total dynamically.

Is the checkout button customizable?

Absolutely. You can change the button text (e.g., “Order Cash on Delivery”, “Buy Now (COD)”), set custom background and text colors, and enable attention-grabbing shake animations. Upgrade to Premium for 10 advanced animation styles with full per-animation color and label control.

What is the RevBoostLab SDK used for?

The plugin uses the RevBoostLab SDK for plugin update checks and an optional opt-in telemetry system. No data is ever collected without your explicit confirmation. See the Privacy Policy section for full details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fix: Replaced time() with static version string on all asset enqueue calls for browser caching compliance.
  • Improvement: Moved all inline <style> and <script> tags to external enqueued files (wp_enqueue_style, wp_enqueue_script, wp_localize_script) for WordPress.org guideline compliance.
  • New: Added assets/css/admin-upsell.css — upsell page layout styles.
  • New: Added assets/css/upsell-animations.css — premium animation keyframes (fallback showcase).
  • New: Added assets/js/admin-menu.js — admin sidebar “Get Premium” link external redirect.
  • New: Added assets/js/upsell-redirect.js — premium page auto-redirect script.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release.
  • Highly responsive checkout popup form modal.
  • Integrated dynamic area-based delivery calculators.
  • Added upsell order bump compatibility.
  • Integrated real-time customizer mockup settings.
